messages:
Maria (People Ops): Final notice: annual compliance attestation + privacy training deadline is this Friday EOD. Please complete the online attestation and upload any SOC2/ISO evidence you own. Form: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/compliance/attestation-2026 :warning:

Maria (People Ops): What we need: affirmation of training, role-based data handling flag, and links to evidence (Confluence/Drive). Short notes are fine if artifacts are pending.

Liam (Security): For infra folks: please attach your quarterly access review and any KMS/HSM configuration export. Those are required for SOC2 infra control mapping.

Devon (Legal): Reminder: if youre adding third-party processor contracts, redact sensitive CLAs and include just the processor name, scope, and effective dates. We can pull contracts from Vault if you tag them.

Sam (Platform): Quick heads up — if youre on the Dedicated team and use customer-provided keys, mark the "customer KMS" box. That affects evidence scoping.

Maria (People Ops): Extension process: submit the exception form (https://forms.redwoodinference.com/comp-exception) with a short reason and ETA. Ask before Friday.

Liam (Security): If youre unsure whether an artifact qualifies, paste the link here and Ill confirm. Small things like logs with timestamps are acceptable if redacted.

Devon (Legal): If you need a one-sentence statement for a partner contract, ping me and Ill draft it.

Sam (Platform): Filed my attestation and linked /evidence/platform/2026-q1.

reminder-bot: Automated DM scheduled: 48h and 6h before deadline to users who havent submitted.

Maria (People Ops): Thanks everyone. If help uploading or redacting is needed, well run a 30-min office hour tomorrow 12:30-1pm in #help. Drop questions here or DM.
